stories.title: Pistons use 23-0 run in fourth quarter to complete comeback over Celtics
Silver: 'No rules issue' with LeBron's helicopter commute
stories.summary: The helicopter used by Philadelphia 76ers forward LeBron James to commute from New York is "perfectly appropriate," NBA commissioner Adam Silver said on "The Pat McAfee Show" on Tuesday.

stories.title: Reports: NFL won't punish Eagles for letting Hurts play with blood clot
stories.summary: The NFL will not punish the Eagles for how they handled the process surrounding quarterback Jalen Hurts being cleared to play Week 5 against the Jaguars, according to multiple reports.

stories.title: Big 12 commish mulls new event if CFP ends conference title games
stories.summary: Big 12 commissioner Brett Yormark said the league would find a new event to replace any lost conference title games should they be casualties of an expanded College Football Playoff.

stories.title: WR McLaurin has season-ending knee injury, Commanders' Quinn says
stories.summary: Commanders wide receiver Terry McLaurin suffered a torn patellar tendon, an injury that will end his season, coach Dan Quinn announced Tuesday.
